data.one_liner: Retrieve device IMEI on Android <10 or ANDROID_ID on newer, and UUID on iOS.
data.what_it_does: This plugin exposes a single method to get a unique device identifier. On Android it returns the IMEI for devices below Android 10, or the ANDROID_ID for newer versions. On iOS it returns a consistent UUID string.
use_when: You need a stable device identifier for analytics or feature gating.
You need to identify a device across app launches without storing data locally.
avoid_when: You are concerned about privacy or need to comply with regulations that restrict IMEI usage.
You only need a generic device ID that can be reset, such as for testing.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS with consistent behavior.
No build_runner or code generation required.
weaknesses: IMEI is not available on Android 10+; falls back to ANDROID_ID which may change on factory reset.
data.setup_notes: Add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE"/> to AndroidManifest.xml for Android <10. No additional native steps required.
